'''Kint Zsam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He rewarded a hunter in his hunting party with a [[Chiss poacher backpack]] after they cleared the [[Hracca Glade]] of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] poachers and defeated a mighty [[Kkorrwrot]] beast.
